---

## 🎓 CFA Institute — Overview

CFA Institute is the global association of investment professionals. It sets the standards for professional excellence and credentials, champions ethical behavior in investment markets, and serves as the leading source of learning and research for the investment industry. It believes in fostering an environment where investors' interests come first, markets function at their best, and economies grow.

With more than **200,000 charterholders** worldwide across more than **160 markets**, CFA Institute has 8 offices and 157 local societies.

---

## 📋 The CFA Program

The CFA exam consists of **three levels**: Level I, Level II, and Level III. Each level of the curriculum builds on the prior level, becoming increasingly complex.

To earn the CFA charter, you must **pass all three CFA exams**, complete **4,000 hours** of relevant professional work experience over a minimum of three years, and become a CFA Institute member.

Once completed, you can become a globally recognized **Chartered Financial Analyst® (CFA®)** — a prestigious distinction that differentiates you in the competitive finance industry.

---

## 📅 Exam Schedule & Fees

CFA Program exams take place **four times a year** around the world — usually in **February, May, August, and November**.

Total exam fees for all three levels of the CFA Program range from **USD $3,520 – $4,600**, depending on whether you register during the early or standard registration window.

You can take the CFA exam a maximum of **twice each calendar year**, but not in consecutive windows or windows within six months of each other.

---

## 📊 Recent Pass Rates (November 2025)

- **Level I:** Of the 26,752 candidates worldwide who sat for the Level I exam in November 2025, **43%** passed. The Level I pass rate exceeded the 10-year average of 41%, with first-time candidates achieving a pass rate of **49%**.

- **Level II:** Of the 15,003 candidates worldwide who sat for the Level II exam in November 2025, **42%** passed. First-time Level II candidates achieved a pass rate of **50%**, while candidates with at least one deferral had a **27%** pass rate.

---

## 📚 Curriculum Highlights

For **Level III**, candidates choose one of three **"specialized pathway" options** at registration and receive study materials related to the selected pathway. 65–70% of the Level III exam topic weight relates to the common core, while the remaining 30–35% relates to the selected pathway.
